newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Want Want sees better second half.
newsitem.headline: Want Want sees better second half.

text.p: Taiwan snack maker Want Want Holdings said on Monday it expects its second half performance to be better than the first half.
The company announced a first half net profit rise of 35.2 percent to Singapore $28.94 million for the period ended June 30.
Want Want, which makes rice crakers, said China continues to be the key market accounting for about 71 percent and 90 percent of the group's turnover and pre-tax profit in the first-half.

The stronger performance in China was attributed mainly to the addition of new production lines in the latter half of 1995 which enabled it to raise production output in 1996. The penetration into inner regions of China also led to a higher turnover. -- Singapore newsroom (65 8703080)
